keyboard.action: Collapsed rows are inert: they are skipped until the group is expanded

differences.text: The group header and rows with a result detail are native <button>s with aria-expanded (upstream: div role=button with tabindex and hand-written key handlers). The collapsed count carries hidden text "{count} tool calls" so the header's name says what the number counts.

Rows are matched by `key`, else by name and occurrence, never by status: upstream's derived key includes the status, so a running call that completes remounts its row and closes an open detail. Here it stays open.

A call that fails is announced once (politely, through the Announcer) as "{name}: Error: {message}", because the enclosing message list's native live region is off (CHATLIST-01) and a listener would otherwise not learn of it. Calls that arrive already failed (history) and every other status change stay silent: the status text is in the reading order.

Status, additions and deletions use --color-text-green / --color-text-red ink (the React theme's chat-tool-calls override): the filled --color-success / --color-error fall under 4.5:1 with the hover wash. Pending and running use tct-spinner shade=subtle.

The group opens with grid-template-rows 0fr to 1fr inside prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference; collapsed content is `inert` (removed from the tab order and the accessibility tree). `interpolate-size` was evaluated and rejected: Chrome only.

core.chat-tool-calls.notes: Guides: [mwg:animate-to-intrinsic-sizes] (evaluated; grid rows technique used, `interpolate-size` is Chrome only); [mwg:accessibility] (live regions: one centralised, debounced announcer; a status change is not worth speech unless it fails); [mwg:accessible-web-components] (ARIA relations inside one tree).
